result.title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
result.summary: As context windows scale to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, KV cache compression has become essential for efficient LLM inference. Existing methods fall into three families: score-based eviction, summary compensation, and offload-and-recall. Yet all three decide what to keep or recall by content relevance to the current query. We show this shared design is structurally incomplete. A cache supports two access modes: associative lookup by content and sequential traversal by position; current compressors implement only the first. The gap matters in practice: retrieval-augmented generation, code completion, and structured-data extraction all require the model to reproduce identifiers, field values, or code tokens verbatim from the context. Under compression, content-based eviction retains the head of such a sequence but discards its continuation, causing verbatim copying to break irreversibly midway, a failure we call sequential forgetting. This failure resists better scoring, larger budgets, summary compensation, and dynamic re-scoring; it is the dominant source of remaining quality loss under compression. We propose KVFetch, a training-free, drop-in framework that opens a temporal recall channel for any score-based compressor. It demotes evicted candidates to a quantized cold tier, detects active copying through a monotone read pointer, and prefetches positional successors into fixed-size hot-tier slots without increasing attention cost. On RULER-16K under an iso-budget control, KVFetch recovers verbatim copying from 0.8 to 78.4 and raises the 13-task average by +8.4, with gains concentrating on tasks that require sequential access. On LongBench, where no task requires sequential access, the channel remains dormant and imposes no cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作指出 KV cache 压缩只实现了按内容的相关性检索，而忽略了按位置的顺序遍历需求，导致逐字复制类任务出现「顺序遗忘」；为此提出免训练的 KVFetch，把被淘汰的 KV 降级到量化冷层，用单调读指针检测复制行为，并按位置预取后继 token 到固定大小的热层槽位。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 中 latent 缓存、检索证据筛选与状态更新的成本问题直接相关：其「内容检索 vs 位置顺序访问」的区分可供核查 latent 表示是否同样丢失顺序/位置结构，以及按需预取与停止/取用决策的对应关系。
